seo.title: Work with ODD — Creative Partnerships, Projects & Production
seo.description: Bring ODD a question, brief, event or partnership idea. We work across creative practice, cultural context, strategy and production to find the right form for the work.

title: Start with the question, not the format.
intro: Bring us a brief, event or partnership idea — even if the format is still open. ODD is most useful when the work needs cultural understanding, strategy and production in the same project.

whenOddIsUseful.headline: For projects that need cultural understanding, concept development and delivery in one team.

items.title: The brief is open and the right format isn’t obvious yet.
items.body: We can help frame what the work actually needs before deciding whether the answer is an event, partnership, programme, campaign or something else.

items.title: You need cultural understanding and reliable delivery in the same project.
items.body: ODD works inside creative and cultural contexts, but we also build and deliver work with companies, cities and institutions.

items.title: You need people who don't usually end up in the same room.
items.body: Sometimes the value is in giving people from different disciplines a clear reason, role and setting in which to work together.

whatWeDo.headline: We combine creative practice, cultural understanding and production.
whatWeDo.body: ODD runs its own events and its own space, works with artists and cultural organisations, and delivers work with companies and institutions. We build each team around the brief rather than working from a fixed roster.

pathways.title: ODDference
pathways.body: The easiest way for organisations to experience ODD. Come yourself, bring colleagues, or build something around the event with us.

pathways.title: Partnerships
pathways.body: Bring resources, expertise or an idea into ODDference, ODDfest, ODDspace or another project where there is a clear reason to build something together.

pathways.meta: A concrete brief, question or idea
pathways.title: ODDagency
pathways.body: For briefs and questions that need cultural understanding, concept development and a team built for the work.

impact.title: Two years of ODD, in numbers.

casesIntro.headline: What we’ve built with our partners
casesIntro.body: Examples of what partners have made possible with ODD.

cases.title: BajaMyArt
cases.summary: At ODDfest 2025 the festival's portable toilets became artworks. Humak's cultural-production students produced it, Lassila & Tikanoja provided the units, and an open call brought in artists, a collective and a community workshop — including a gold-draped shrine people queued for.

cases.title: Just Give a F*ck
cases.summary: Before ODDfest 2025, RFSU, Outshine, Adventure Club and ODD turned a digital outdoor screen in Kamppi into a game you played with your body. Passers-by waved their arms to win festival tickets and merch, and RFSU’s message got its own street corner: using a condom is caring.

cases.title: Arthur C. Brooks at ODDfest
cases.summary: We brought Harvard professor and happiness researcher Arthur C. Brooks to Finland for ODDfest 2025: a keynote on the main stage and a smaller conversation with Humak on happiness, meaning and entrepreneurship. Humak and the Hjelt Foundation made the visit possible with us.

cases.title: Oddlygood at ODDfest
cases.summary: ODDfest has no standard brand booths, so Oddlygood didn’t bring one. Oddlygood handed out drinks in exchange for ideas on how to recycle better, and Skyproduction filmed the day.

cases.title: ODD100
cases.summary: A hundred leading voices from Finnish culture in the same room: organisation leaders, decision-makers, journalists, artists and curators. KULTA ry, the central organisation for Finnish culture and arts associations, curated the guest list with us. The City of Helsinki sponsored the tickets in 2025, and ODD100 came back in 2026.
cases.linkLabel: Read more in the impact report →

cases.title: LUO(V)UUS award 2025
cases.partner: City of Tampere · Music x Media
cases.summary: The City of Tampere named ODDfest its 2025 creative-economy innovator at the Music x Media Industry Awards Gala. The jury picked us for an open-minded way of building cooperation between creative industries and for having the courage to try a different model for that cooperation.
